100% AI-assisted development. Zero tracking. Zero ads. 100% free.
Dedicated "Only Once" Alarm Option — easily set alarms to ring only once and turn off automatically upon ringing or dismissal
Timer Label & Numbering Fix — resolved %d display glitch and auto-renumber remaining timers sequentially upon deletion
12H / 24H Alarm Format Consistency — alarm times across dashboard list, dialogs, preview, and notifications now strictly follow your chosen clock format
Flexible Recurrence Engine — support for Daily, Weekly, Monthly (e.g. 20th, 3rd Tuesday, selected dates), and Yearly cycles (e.g. 20th Oct, 3rd Tuesday of Oct, selected months)
Live Snooze Notification — displays live remaining countdown, exact time snoozed, and snooze duration with instant dismiss
Enhanced Snoozed Ringing Screen — full-screen ringing now displays live current time and timestamp of when the alarm was snoozed
One-Off Alarm Fix — one-off alarms now automatically disable upon ringing and dismissal, preventing unwanted daily recurring ringing
Comprehensive Offline Localization — complete translation across all screens, tabs, dialogs, timers, stopwatch, settings, release notes and ringing UI in 11 languages
Priority First-Run Language Gate — language picker presented immediately upon launch prior to system permissions
Consistent Standard Digits — numerals remain strictly 1, 2, 3 across all localized views for universal readability
Multilingual Support Foundation — added in-app language picker and 11 offline language resource translations
First-Run Setup Dialog — prompt users for preferred language and theme on install
In-App Language Settings — easily switch display language anytime from Settings
Android 9 Compatibility Fix — eliminated cold-launch abrupt quits on Android 9 and older versions
Timer & Stopwatch API Guard — guarded API 31 foreground service notifications to ensure flawless background tracking on all Android versions
Timer Alert Stop on Clear/Reset — tapping Clear or Reset now immediately silences the ringing sound
Smart Notification Navigation & Title — notification title dynamically reflects Timer vs Stopwatch and tap opens the exact active tab
Clean Alarm Lifecycle — guaranteed immediate dismiss & lock screen restore without background leakage
F-Droid Compliance — clean open-source metadata, Apache-2.0 license, removed network update checkers
Permission Streamlining — streamlined permission gate for modern and legacy Android systems
Non-dismissible background notification — timer & stopwatch notification cannot be swiped away while running, with a \'Stop All\' action button
Light mode alarm time fix — cyclic and weekly alarm times now use deep, high-contrast colours instead of washed-out tints
Deeper light mode tint — default background is more noticeably grey-blue so the whiteness slider feels meaningful
Persistent Custom Track — last-used music file auto-applied to every new alarm
Multiple Timers — run up to 5 independent countdown timers simultaneously
Pure Dark Mode — true AMOLED black theme for OLED screen battery savings
Light Mode Brightness Slider — adjust background brightness from tinted to pure white
Background Timer & Stopwatch — continue running when app is backgrounded via Foreground Service
Rings in Silent & DND Mode — alarms bypass ringer volume, no more missed alarms
Official Package Rebrand — package updated to com.beemasfincon.cyclicalarms
Reliability Improvements — upgraded alarm scheduling and foreground service lifecycle handling
Timer — built-in countdown timer with progress ring, quick presets (1m–30m), sound & vibration alert
Stopwatch — elapsed time tracker with lap recording, fastest/slowest lap highlights, touch audio tones
Strict Lock Screen Privacy — app only shows over keyguard while actively ringing; dismiss/snooze immediately locks & returns
4-Tab Navigation — Alarms, Timer, Stopwatch, Settings (with embedded About sub-page)
Default Cyclic — new alarms open on Cyclic Days tab by default
Icon Fit Fix — app icon no longer appears cropped on launcher
Pencil-Sketched Spiral Alarm Icon — clean, symmetrical alarm clock launcher icon
Per-Alarm Custom Snooze — set desired snooze duration (5, 10, 15, 20m or custom minutes)
Native Lock Screen Ringing — rings smoothly over keyguard without PIN unlock prompt
Dedicated Page Navigation — clean layout for Alarms, History, Settings & About
12H / 24H Clock Toggle — select preferred format with uppercase \'PM\'/\'AM\'
Year Display in Date — home clock displays full year (e.g. Sat, Sep 5, 2026)
First-Launch Theme Prompt & Status Bar Fix — seamless light/dark theme icon visibility
In-App Permissions Manager — view and manage notification, exact alarm & overlay access
Support & Community Card — moved to About page for easy feedback & bug reporting
Dark / Light / System theme selector in Settings
Alarm editor now defaults to current time
Minute spinner always visible — no more invisible digits
New High Pitch alarm sound — loud dual-tone alert
Volume defaults to maximum for new alarms
